fields.description: A short, one-line summary of what this skill does.
fields.label: Description

fields.description: Turn this on to make the skill available.
fields.label: Is Enabled

fields.description: Check this for command-only skills (slash menu) or reference/library skills. When checked, the skill won't appear in the system prompt it's only shown when explicitly called.
fields.label: Disable Model Invocation

fields.description: Placeholder text shown in the slash menu for command-type skills. Example: 'customer name' or 'order number'. Only appears when 'Disable Model Invocation' is checked.
fields.label: Argument Hint

fields.description: Link this skill to a parent skill. Use this for reference materials or sub-skills that belong to a main skill.
fields.label: Parent Skill

fields.description: A short identifier used to build a unique name: '{parent-skill}-{this-slug}'. Prevents naming conflicts when multiple skills share the same parent. Required when Parent Skill is set.
fields.label: Reference Slug

fields.description: The main body of the skill — instructions, guidance, or reference material. This is what the AI sees when the skill is loaded. Leave empty if this skill only uses an attachment or server script.
fields.label: Content

fields.description: Upload a template, reference document, or asset file. Stored privately regardless of upload settings.
fields.label: Attach

fields.description: Link a Server Script to make this skill executable. The script handles the actual logic and permissions.
fields.label: Server Script

fields.description: Extra information in key-value format (e.g., category, author, related DocTypes). Must be valid JSON.
fields.label: Metadata
